_about: One beat per caption line, in caption order. While the voice reads the line, the replay plays match time 'from' to 'to' (seconds on the broadcast clock, the dataset timebase), slowed to fit the words, then holds a freeze-frame on 'to' until the next line. 'hl' lists the event indexes whose ball paths light up. The voice sets the pace.
